_comment: Copy of each workflow job-and-trigger pair's `live-e2e plan|run` argument list, one key per pair: <job>.<trigger> where a job has more than one trigger (smoke, standard and full each take a dispatch), else the trigger alone. The workflow itself is private-plane only; there test/workflow.test.ts asserts the set of lists in live-e2e.yml equals the set here, in both directions. The public select tests read every entry. deploy, nightly and poll always carry a tier of smoke or higher and no --tag.
